about_the_game:
Please note: this is a demo version of the game with some content available. Multiplayer is not included.

In Host, you and your friends will play as prisoners who have been invited to participate in the "show." There will be 5 games that will test your bravery, stealth skills, intelligence, and resistance to criticism. The Host will comment on everything and guide you throughout the whole experience.

Game Features:

There will be several scenarios with completely different gameplay:

  • First Game:
    You will need to find and activate terminals in a huge abandoned factory. Monsters — and even your friends — will try to prevent you from activating them all. Your only tool will be a flashlight, which you must recharge at special stations.

  • Second Game:
    You will be placed in a large labyrinth that you must escape first. Lockers for hiding, a shotgun for defense, lurking monsters, and cold concrete walls — that's all you have.

  • Third Game:
    Here, you'll discover who is the "dumbest" among your group. A large set of logical and general knowledge questions will determine the winner — and the loser.

  • Fourth Game:
    Things get a bit more interesting. You'll search for valuable items hidden among mountains of trash in another abandoned location. Monsters will be present again, but this time their behavior will be different.

  • Fifth Game:
    Currently in development. We will update this text as soon as the fifth game is completed.

name: HOST Demo
short_description: Host is a multiplayer horror game where you and up to three friends compete to find out who is the most fearless, smart and agile. You play as prisoners taking part in a show that inculdes five different games.
supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Traditional Chinese, Turkish, Ukrainian
*languages with full audio support
